#ifndef ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_CLEANUP_H_
#define ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_CLEANUP_H_

#include <zephyr/toolchain.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Define a cleanup helper function.
 *
 * @param _type Type of the variable to clean up.
 * @param _name Name of the cleanup helper.
 * @param _code Cleanup code to execute, where `_var` is the variable value.
 */
#define DEFINE_CLEANUP(_type, _name, _code)				\
	static inline void __cleanup_##_name(_type *ptr)		\
	{								\
		_type _var = *ptr;					\
		_code;							\
	}

/**
 * @brief Declare a variable with automatic cleanup.
 *
 * @param _name Name of the cleanup helper defined with DEFINE_CLEANUP.
 */
#define __cleanup(_name) __attribute__((__cleanup__(__cleanup_##_name)))

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_INCLUDE_CLEANUP_H_ */
